# discord_invites (Data Source)

Lists the invites of a server. Requires the Manage Server or View Audit Log permission. Discord only returns `max_age`, `max_uses`, `uses`, `temporary` and `created_at` when the bot has Manage Server; otherwise they are zero, false or null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_invites" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "permanent_invites" {
  value = [for i in data.discord_invites.all.invites : i.code if i.max_age == 0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `invites` (Attributes List) The invites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invites))

<a id="nestedatt--invites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invites`

Read-Only:

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the invite is for.
- `code` (String) Invite code.
- `created_at` (String) When the invite was created.
- `expires_at` (String) When the invite expires; null for never.
- `max_age` (Number) Seconds the invite is valid for after it was created; 0 for forever.
- `max_uses` (Number) Maximum number of uses; 0 for unlimited.
- `temporary` (Boolean) Whether the invite grants temporary membership.
- `uses` (Number) Number of times the invite was used.
